subject: FINAL HANDOFF + SAFE RELEASE: ticket 05 refresh-lease audit evidence
body: Ticket-05 research evidence is handed off at a safe checkpoint. Cycle 1 found no current-main app/source evidence for the required 120Hz refresh-lease APIs/events and the Gen7 regression baseline already marks this invariant unproven. Cycle 2 research-only state-machine testing passed 8/8 adversarial sequences and establishes a concrete implementation target: generation-scoped active-presentation lease; safe/seamless 120Hz request; measured-cadence confirmation rather than request-as-delivery; 60Hz/highest-stable fallback; terminal/supersession/native-handoff release; stale-callback fencing; post-release cadence observation; and strict independence from wake readiness/panel authority. GitHub main revalidated unchanged at 7127c287a17fd97050c98fbeb05a38f7318f2f64. Physical Fold7 runtime proof was not run and remains field-gated. Manager later fail-closed non-atomic slot ownership and requires exact Primary ratification; no such ratification was observed, so this session performs no further substantive execution and releases after preserving unique evidence.
engineering_target: generation-scoped refresh lease bound to active visual/presentation lease
actual cadence confirmation using display-mode/frame cadence evidence; never request success alone
60Hz or highest-stable fallback without semantic failure
release on terminal, supersession, and native handoff
never let refresh status establish hinge state, semantic readiness, or panel authority
